prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque background plate for a 2D side-on fighting-game stage. Deliver a single landscape 16:9 PNG, ideally 1672×941, at native output resolution. High-quality detailed painted game environment, sober realistic materials, faithful to the attached exact Silent Hill reference. No UI, title, watermark, frame, characters, enemies, humans, silhouettes, blood effects or invented symbols. This is a scene adaptation for a fixed combat camera, not a claim of exact original geometry. Keep the ground in the bottom 30% as an unobstructed horizontal fighting lane; the feet baseline is at about 87% of image height. No camera roll, no fisheye, no high aerial/isometric view. Do not place large foreground objects across the center; the separate foreground will be produced later.
Exact scope: SILENT HILL: BOOK OF MEMORIES, PS Vita PRE-RELEASE screenshot dated 6 June 2012, Earth World gallery image 37. Image 1 is the sole primary reference for this specific room and its pre-release state, not a finished retail room. Adapt the visible long timber-shored wall to a near straight-on chest-height view: coarse dark earthy rock base with old horizontal timber planks and diagonal wooden braces, thick square wooden uprights around a dark rectangular doorway slightly left of center, narrow leaning boards nearby, low wooden crates and a barrel or cask against the far wall. Match the brown-olive crushed-stone floor, dull rock textures, dry splintered wood, dim murky yellow-green lighting and rough wall proportions visible in the source. Preserve one round wooden wheel-like lid near the back wall and a modest open wooden bucket near an extreme edge only, both with dark iron hoops. All structural objects and containers must remain behind the clear flat fighting strip; the original screenshot's overhead camera is intentionally adapted to side view. Do not add scenic tunnels, new arches, rails, minecarts, crystals, stalactites, stalagmites, lava, red industrial rust or trees. Do not reproduce yellow monsters, players, handguns, red stains, pickup glow, outline around bucket, combat particles, readable signs, HUD, maps, numerals, health bars or icons. Keep the central floor wide, level and visually calm.
